summary: Register lists a Tyler County Peach Tree Village tower as gone, about 3 km from the village; no source describes the tower or its site.

facts.status_note: Register lists the tower as gone. No source found describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Register lists the tower as gone. It gives no build date, removal date or cause.

evidence.supports: Register row for the Peach Tree Village tower: Tyler County, coordinates, marked Tower Gone
evidence.quote: Peach Tree Village Tyler 30.97220 -94.60355 Tower Gone

notes_for_editor: No tower-specific history found after two searches. The register point (30.97220, -94.60355) is about 3 km north-northeast of the village coordinates from the ghost-town guide; that distance is computed, not sourced, and may mean the tower stood elsewhere on the village land. The Camp Ta-Ku-La text is on the 'Peach Tree Village Hall' card, which appears on the Tyler County artifacts page at the cited URL; the 'Fire Tower' card on that page is generic and names no site. The story cites the page only for the Camp Ta-Ku-La statement about the village buildings. Access and visit facts are unknown and omitted. The village is the subject of several sources; the tower itself is not. Story body about 149 words.
